info.title: Open Trivia DB connector
info.description: Connector for Open Trivia DB, a free to use, user-contributed trivia question database.

response_code.description: The API appends a "Response Code" to each API Call to help tell what the API is doing.
response_code.title: Response Code

type.description: The type of question. Either multiple or boolean.
type.title: Type

difficulty.description: The difficulty level of the question. Either easy, medium, hard.
difficulty.title: Difficulty

question.description: The trivia question to be answered.
question.title: Question

correct_answer.description: The correct answer to the question.
correct_answer.title: Correct Answer

incorrect_answers.description: The incorrect answers to the question.
incorrect_answers.title: Incorrect Answers

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: The number of questions to retrieve. Maximum number allowed is 50.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: The category of questions to be retrieved. Only 1 Category can be requested per API Call. To get questions from any category, don't specify a category.

parameters.name: difficulty
parameters.description: The difficulty of a question. Can be either "easy", "medium", or "hard".  To get questions from any difficulty, don't specify a difficulty.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The type of question. Either "multiple" for multiple choice or "boolean" for true/false.

get.description: This will request trivia questions from Open Trivia DB.
